model_output.score_comment_short: Your recent work pairs patient volume and program completion with a functional outcome.
model_output.score_comment_long: The current role gives a clear picture of your patient load, mentoring and program work. The return-to-run program and function scores would be easier to interpret with a little more detail. Explain what the program involved and how the scores were reported.
model_output.score_plain: Your resume gives a reviewer concrete reasons to consider your outpatient orthopedic work. A few targeted edits could make your clinical approach easier to understand.
model_output.first_impression: Your current role combines sports rehabilitation with mentoring and scheduling. The return-to-run program stands out, though its contents aren't yet described.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Mentor 2 newer therapists and set the PT aide schedule" doesn't explain what your mentoring covers, making that part of the senior role difficult to assess.
model_output.summary: The return-to-run program had 85 completions in 2025, a useful detail that shows patients participated in something you built. Your work centers on outpatient orthopedic and post-surgical rehabilitation, with a prior mix of orthopedic and neurological cases. The current title and mentoring responsibilities place you at a senior therapist level. A reviewer may still want to know how you structured the program before understanding what you contributed to its design.
strengths: The 2025 patient-reported function result gives a concrete view of improvement among discharged patients.
Daily patient ranges in both roles show the pace of your outpatient work without relying on a generic caseload claim.
Leading a fall-prevention class for older adults adds group instruction to your individual treatment background.
gaps: The resume doesn't identify the function-score measure or how the reported percentage was calculated, which makes the result harder to interpret.
The fall-prevention bullet doesn't say what the class covered or how you adapted it for participants.
The skills list names dry needling and two record systems, but doesn't show how you used them in your clinical work.

top_fixes.why: The completion count shows participation, but the design details would show what you built.
